freeze_statement: These 20 cases, their 20 distinct evaluation seeds, their neutral case IDs and the exact inference settings were authored and frozen BEFORE any project output was generated or viewed. Cases were NOT selected using recognition scores, rendering quality or erasure outcomes. Categories are assigned from prompt metadata (what the prompt asks for), not from any image.
content_policy: Ordinary non-sensitive content. No named artists, no protected characters, no people, no brands.

inference_settings.initial_noise_handling: For each case, packed initial latents are built once from torch.Generator(device='cpu').manual_seed(eval_seed) via FluxPipeline.prepare_latents, sha256-hashed, persisted to disk, and then passed explicitly as `latents=` to BOTH the M0 and the edited run. Identical seeds alone are not treated as proof of pairing; the stored tensor and its hash are the proof.

preservation_rule: Every case is preserved and published, including cases where the target is absent in M0, where erasure is weak, where the object is substituted or deformed, and where an output is black or saturated. Missing or corrupt outputs are recorded explicitly as missing rows; prompts and seeds are never replaced and completeness is never manufactured.
gate: Technical integrity only. There is no detector-recognition, suppression, retention or visual-quality pass threshold. No automated judges and no scientific human labels are applied.
